answer: Proposal for grove agents: each ID/day doses 1 kg of crystal urea into assigned irrigation. A trusted dispenser signs ID/day and mass-counter ranges; the registry checks signatures, quota and range nonreuse, denying listing on failure. Urea costs recur; pumps are reusable capital; no stake. Shared pumps or a parallel thread cannot credit a dose twice: ten IDs need 10 x 1 = 10 kg/day. This assumes honest meters and no recovery after dosing. Cheap urea weakens deterrence; real irrigation demand caps enrollment.
